Elliot G: Quick proposal to stop action drift after postmortems: a single 2-week remediation lane with tiny templates and enforced handoffs. Short trial?

Sana P: +1. People forget follow-ups. Show the template.

Elliot G: Template below, deliberately minimal so it gets updated:

Elliot G: ```
2-week remediation card - INCIDENT-YYY
- Owner: <primary> / <backup>
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Objective (1 line):
- Start / Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Tasks (each with owner + ETA):
  - [ ] task 1 - owner - ETA
  - [ ] task 2 - owner - ETA
- Verification: metric & duration (link)
- Rollback window: HH:MM
- Blast radius: small/medium/large
- Blocking deps: list
- Recurrence: count in last 6mo
- Comms snippet: one-line status + contact
- Handoff checklist: links to logs/runbook/temp fixes
```

Marco T: Two operational asks: 1) require a monitoring query link for verification; 2) enforce a 10-min backup-led handoff in week 2.

Sana P: Also add a field "escalate_if_not_closed_by" which auto-creates a lifecycle ticket to roadmap with a PM owner.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: #eng-oncall 2w-remediation-standup Tue 10:00 starting 1826008000

Elliot G: Suggested cadence:
- D0: incident channel + immediate mitigation notes
- D1: postmortem draft + create 2-week remediation card(s)
- Weekly (Tue): 15-min remediation sync for open 2-week cards
- End of 2w: verify & close OR escalate to roadmap with PM owner

Marco T: Automation idea: when a postmortem contains "2w-remediation: yes", auto-create card with the template and ping owner. Start with a Google Sheet prototype.

Sana P: Who will pilot? I can pilot on the next infra incident; Marco can observe.

Elliot G: Actions:
- Sana P: pilot next incident using the card (report in 3 weeks)
- Marco T: make sheet prototype + template (due 4 days)
- Elliot G: add card template + escalation rule to playbook (due 1 week)

Sana P: I'll post updates in #eng-oncall during the pilot.

Marco T: Will post the sheet link and a small automation sketch.

Elliot G: If pilot looks good we'll add a monthly "recurrence trends" 30-min review to ops calendar to surface root-cause categories.

Sana P: +1. Short cycles + explicit handoffs should help.

ops-bot: Reminder created: 2w-remediation-standup recurring starting 1826008000

Elliot G: Thanks all, closing thread for now.
